title: The reserved application heartbeat is probed like any optional field
description: A browser subscribe carrying the reserved heartbeat_ms field is rejected, because no server implements it and none needs to: the server-detects-dead-client direction is carried by protocol-level pings alone (WP-DISCONNECT), which a browser answers below the JavaScript API. The field stays reserved for the opposite direction, a client detecting a dead server, so this rejection is the capability probe working rather than a gap. Still unexecuted: the expected frame is a Response, which is deliberately outside the type-discriminated server_message union and so carries no type, while the corpus gate requires a string type on every s2c message. The same mismatch blocks the four other response-shaped scenarios.
